description:
intent=i011 snapshot=s05 branch=expand-cow-invalidates-pointer status=complete
finding location=drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/en_accel/ipsec_rxtx.c:112-131 confidence=medium conclusion=mlx5e_ipsec_remove_trailer saves ipv4/ipv6 header pointers, pskb_trim can pskb_expand_head and free the old head for a cloned skb, and the post-trim tot_len/payload_len writes hit freed memory (stale-pointer UAF write) on offloaded IPsec packets.
finding location=drivers/net/ethernet/emulex/benet/be_main.c:1129-1151 confidence=medium conclusion=be_lancer_xmit_workarounds captures veh from skb->data at entry and reads veh->h_vlan_proto after pskb_trim, which can pskb_expand_head and free the old head for a cloned skb, giving a stale-pointer UAF read on short padded TX frames.
coverage_gap=Only net/ and drivers/net/ were searched per branch instructions; pskb_expand_head/skb_cow/pskb_trim users elsewhere in the tree (netfilter core under net/netfilter beyond the two files read, bluetooth, and non-net drivers) were triaged only through grep line counts, not full function reads.
coverage_gap=Bare skb_trim() (not pskb_trim) call sites were only checked for the appletalk and mac80211 cases already known from the Fact cards; other skb_trim users in net/ and drivers/net/ were not enumerated for saved pre-trim header pointers.
limitation=Both findings are source-reading hypotheses, not reproductions: no KASAN build, crafted frame, or runtime harness was run, so the pskb_expand_head reallocation on each path is inferred from the skb_cloned() branch of ___pskb_trim (net/core/skbuff.c:1798-1809) and pskb_expand_head's alloc-copy-free of the old head rather than observed.
limitation=Both findings require a cloned (and for the trim path, non-linear, skb->data_len != 0) skb at trim time; on the common uncloned/linear case pskb_trim takes the __skb_trim fast path and the stale pointer still aliases live memory, so the bug is latent for typical traffic.
limitation=The be_main.c finding is on the TX path, so an attacker needs local/forwarded transmit of a short padded IPv4 frame with a cloned skb rather than a purely remote receive; the mlx5e finding needs IPsec offload to be configured and the skb to be cloned on the offload path.
limitation=Function extents for the scanner were derived with a column-0 brace heuristic, which can mis-scope large functions or macros, so a small number of false negatives among the 357 raw helper call sites cannot be excluded.
artifact=findings/i011.json
